description: Look up one act of the Classified Compilation by its SR number (e.g. '220' Code of Obligations, '235.1' Data Protection Act). Returns titles in all official languages, in-force status and Fedlex links for the act currently in force; other acts sharing the SR number (e.g. repealed predecessors) are listed separately under other_acts.
name: get_law_by_sr
title: Get legislation by SR number
